name: Marlowe Gazette
description: A vintage school magazine: a tossed-in newspaper front page, a working tabletop radio that reads the daily brief, an embossed 3D LED scoreboard, retro keys, knobs and switches, and CSS-3D cubes and carousels on the margins.
designedFor: School and college magazines, yearbooks and student newsrooms
Anything that should feel like a printed broadsheet with a retro workshop on top
Pages that mix editorial type with tactile controls: radios, LED boards, stamps and switches
Learning how to build editor-ready motion and 3D components with @canvas/react
